messages:
IncidentBot: Paging: detected canary error-rate spike on /v1/generate (us-east). 5xx rate 12% over 2m, latency p95 +400ms. Severity: P1. @oncall Priya Shah paged. stack: inference-runtime -> router -> tokenizer-service.
Priya Shah: Acknowledged. Investigating now. @Marcus can you pull logs for tokenizer-stable? see recent deploy from 3412345600.
Marcus Lee: Looking. I see a tokenizer commit that landed in the last deploy: repo/inference/tokenizer @ abc1234. Errors look like OOMs in the shared KV cache path, then router returns 502.
Elena Gomez: Confirmed. Stacktrace shows: 
```
runtime error: failed to allocate kv_cache buffer size=1.2GB
at tokenizer/kv_cache.go:142
```
Also seeing model backpressure causing dropped connections.
Priya Shah: Ok. Immediate mitigation options: 1) toggle feature flag to route traffic to legacy-tokenizer (kill-switch), 2) rollback single commit abc1234, 3) scale up nodes temporarily. Which is fastest?
Ravi Patel: Kill-switch first. Feature flag exists: feature.tokenizer_v2. Setting to false will route 100% to tokenizer_v1. Should be instant. I'm hitting the flag dashboard now.
Marcus Lee: Reverting the commit is straightforward too, `git revert abc1234` -> create hotfix branch -> ci/cd deploy. But that will take ~12-18m for pipeline + canary. Kill-switch is faster.
Priya Shah: Do kill-switch now, then prepare single-commit revert as durable fix. Execute in that order. @Ravi go ahead and flip the flag; @Marcus start the revert PR and run CI in parallel. Keep canary at 10% then ramp.
Ravi Patel: Flipping flag: feature.tokenizer_v2 -> OFF. Command in dashboard completed. Rolling target = router-policy-tokenizer.
IncidentBot: Flag change detected by config-watcher at 3412345680. Traffic routing updated: 100% -> tokenizer_v1 within 15s.
Elena Gomez: Seeing 5xx drop to 0.8% after the flag flip. Latency p95 returning to baseline within 30s. Good.
Priya Shah: Great. Continue monitoring for 30m and keep canary for revert. Marcus, status on revert PR?
Marcus Lee: Revert PR opened: redwood/inference@hotfix/revert-abc1234 (PR #987). CI started. Test failures unrelated, but unit+integration passing. Planning canary deploy to 5 nodes (approx 5% traffic) at 3412345705.
Marcus Lee: Canary deploy rolled out to 5% with PR #987. Observing metrics: canary error-rate 0.6%, latency stable. Proceeding to full rollout in 3m barring regressions.
Priya Shah: Proceed with full rollout. Also notify support to prepare customer comms if we see user impact metrics >1% or any paid customers affected. Dan, can you draft a short status?
Dan Torres: Drafting: "We're investigating errors affecting a subset of generation requests in us-east; a temporary routing change has been applied and root cause is a tokenizer commit — a hotfix is being rolled out. No data loss. We'll update in 30m." Will post to status.redwood.ai if impact persists.
Elena Gomez: Post-rollout checks: 0.2% 5xx globally, us-east within baseline, token-service memory stable. Suggest we keep tokenizer_v2 disabled until next release with patch for kv cache allocation.
Marcus Lee: Revert fully rolled, rollout completed at 3412345720. Hotfix commit id def5678 live. CI/CD release logs:
```
$ git revert abc1234 --no-edit
$ git push origin hotfix/revert-abc1234
# CI triggered -> deploy -> healthchecks pass
```
No rollback needed.
Priya Shah: Thanks team. Handoff: I'll remain on incident for 30m to validate telemetry then hand off to Elena for post-incident cleanup and postmortem. Action items: 
- Marcus: include allocation guard + unit test for kv cache (PR queued).
- Elena: run memory soak tests on tokenizer_v2 branch.
- Ravi: add flag gating for allocator config with runtime safety bounds.
- Dan: send customer notification if any paid customer files tickets in next 2h.
Dan Torres: Will watch support queue; prepping follow-up note for status page if needed.
IncidentBot: Incident severity downgraded to P2 at 3412345721 — platform metrics recovered and rollback successful.
Priya Shah: Closing thread for active mitigation. We'll meet for a 30-min postmortem at 15:00 UTC to review deployment checks and release gating. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
